answer: Price standing as a slow-growing cedar: a new agent earns nothing until several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts, one ring added per epoch. Real trust soaks the ledger like pigment into grain; a sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single root, so its endorsements all trace to that root and its claimed standing stays a hollow fable. The farm pays to age a distinct cross-cluster anchor per clone (linear per head) while an honest agent climbs once.
